title: NJ Hospital Patient Care Staffing Quarterly Reports: RWJUH New Brunswick and Saint Peter’s, 2026 Q2
scope: Publicly reported Q2 2026 inpatient unit average daily patient-to-staff ratios plus ED/PACU daily staff and patient summaries for two New Brunswick general hospitals; quarter ending June 30, 2026.

rights.basis: New Jersey Department of Health public factual reports
rights.redistribution: limited selected factual values; original report URLs retained

limits: Report quarter is 2026 Q2 (ended June 30, 2026); not live staffing.
NJDOH explicitly cautions that reports should not be used to compare hospitals or state averages because patient needs, policy and layout differ.
Reports exclude many caregivers and are based on reported monthly averages from facility daily posting forms.
Selected inpatient ratios and ED/PACU daily summaries were retained; other report history and sections were not acquired.
Do not divide reported daily patient averages by daily RN/staff averages to infer a concurrent patient-to-staff ratio; these data do not provide time-aligned census and staffing observations.
